verdict.rationale: USCIS publishes a real system-to-system channel, the Torch developer platform. It has a documented enrollment path: register a developer account, create or join a team, build in a sandbox, pass a demo, then receive production keys. It offers a Case Status API and a FOIA/PA request API that can create requests. The transactional scope is narrow, though, because there is explicitly no filing API and online filing runs only through human myUSCIS accounts. Missing for 10: a machine rail for core filings (forms, G-28, fees), batch or transmitter-style provider programs, system accounts tied to representative delegation, and independent corroboration of the onboarding flow.
